instruction: Reinstate the browser tab that was shut down.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to reopen the last closed tab (yahoo.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator verifies all 3 email service websites are present in open tabs.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_open_tabs_info getter to extract all open tab URLs via Chrome DevTools Protocol
Metric is_expected_tabs properly compares the list of open tab URLs against expected URLs (gmail.com, outlook.com, yahoo.com)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies all 3 tabs are present, which is exactly what the instruction requires
Expected values are semantically correct: the 3 URLs match the tabs that should be open after reopening yahoo.com
No postconfig needed: getter can access Chrome tab state directly via CDP without requiring UI state manipulation
Logic is sound: if user successfully reopens yahoo.com tab, all 3 expected tabs will be present and evaluator will pass
